name: Akari-chan no Otona no Obenkyou!
original_name: あかりちゃんのおとなのお勉強！
source:
At the request of Hitomi, his sister, Yuuma will be the home tutor of his niece Akari during summer vacation.
Taking advantage of Akari's lack of sexual knowledge, Yuuma will teach her...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=1320]official website[/url]]
translation:
应姐姐瞳的要求，优麻将在暑假期间担任侄女明里的家庭教师。
利用明里缺乏性知识的机会，游麻会教她……

[翻译自[url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=1320]官网[/url]]
